derived.ex_ante_real_rate_note: ex-post (policy minus latest CPI); no expectation series
derived.reer_z_10y_note: latest 2026-08 vs trailing 120-month mean (BIS real broad EER)
derived.reserves_12m_pct_note: gross reserves incl. gold, 2025-01 to 2026-01 (IMF International Liquidity)
derived.ctot_12m_pct_note: commodity terms of trade, 2025-05 to 2026-05 (IMF CTOT, net exports to GDP weights)

series_monthly_sources.policy_rate_pct: BIS central bank policy rates (monthly, end of period);  Central bank policy rates - Colombia - Monthly - End of period
series_monthly_sources.fx_per_usd: BIS exchange rates, monthly average, local currency per USD;  Exchange rates against USD Colombia - Colombian peso - Monthly - Average of observations through period
series_monthly_sources.reer_broad_real: BIS real effective exchange rate, broad basket (64 economies), 2020=100
series_monthly_sources.cpi_yoy_pct: IMF CPI database, all items, y/y % change, monthly
series_monthly_sources.policy_rate_imf_pct: IMF MFS interest rates, monetary policy-related rate, % p.a., monthly
series_monthly_sources.reserves_ex_gold_usd_bn: IMF International Liquidity, reserves excluding gold (FX, SDRs, IMF position), USD bn, monthly
series_monthly_sources.gold_reserves_usd_bn: IMF International Liquidity, gold at national valuation, USD bn, monthly
series_monthly_sources.reer_imf_2010: IMF real effective exchange rate, CPI-based, 2010=100, monthly
series_monthly_sources.ctot_net_export_gdp_idx: IMF commodity terms of trade, net export price index weighted by net exports to GDP, rolling weights, Jun-2012=100, monthly
series_monthly_sources.gross_reserves_usd_bn: IMF International Liquidity: reserves excluding gold plus gold at national valuation, USD bn, monthly
